title: State-space models through the lens of ensemble control
abstract: arXiv:2603.13587v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: State-space models (SSMs) are effective architectures for sequential modeling, but a rigorous theoretical understanding of their training dynamics is still lacking. We formulate continuous-time SSM parameter-path optimization as an ensemble optimal control problem: each input sequence generates a corresponding state trajectory in the ensemble, while the trainable parameter path forms a common control shared by all trajectories. Within this formulation, model evaluation is represented by the forward state equation and backward sensitivity propagation by the corresponding adjoint equation. We show that the Hamiltonian gradient with respect to the control variable represents the negative first-variation density of the reduced ensemble objective. translated_title: 从系综控制的视角看状态空间模型
translated_abstract: 状态空间模型（SSMs）是序列建模的有效架构，但对其训练动力学的严格理论理解仍然缺乏。我们将连续时间SSM的参数路径优化表述为一个系综最优控制问题：每个输入序列在系综中生成一条相应的状态轨迹，而可训练的参数路径则构成所有轨迹共享的公共控制。在这一表述框架下，模型评估由前向状态方程表示，反向敏感性传播由相应的伴随方程表示。我们证明，关于控制变量的哈密顿量梯度表示约化系综目标的负一阶变分密度。利用这一表示，我们分析了针对连续时间系综目标的Bregman镜像下降方案；在欧几里得几何中，该方案退化为泛函投影梯度下降。
tldr: 本文将连续时间状态空间模型的参数路径优化表述为系综最优控制问题，证明了哈密顿量梯度对应于约化系综目标的负一阶变分密度，并据此分析了Bregman镜像下降训练方案。
en_tdlr: This paper formulates continuous-time SSM parameter-path optimization as an ensemble optimal control problem, proves that the Hamiltonian gradient equals the negative first-variation density of the reduced ensemble objective, and analyzes a Bregman mirror-descent training scheme based on this representation.
